description: Unofficial BB fan art from Anthology of the Killer. Original gentle animations feature blank-zine sorting and folding, a small poster-card inspection, paper recovery, quiet glances, a two-boot hop and articulated steps in three directions. Pink hair keeps the same covered-eye side and two yellow clips; the orange polka-dot dress is paired with opaque yellow leggings and mint boots. No violent imagery.
author: Cozy Critters Studio
